title: The new suspension formula has a few more wrinkles to keep in mind

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The new suspension formula has a few more wrinkles to keep in mind
sources.description: The NFL and NFL Players Association announced this week, out of the blue, a new procedure for imposing automatic suspensions on players who commit three violations of one of five specific safety rules: hip-drop tackles, horse-collar tackles, launching, hits on defenseless players, and blindside blocks.
